crossRefs.note: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.
Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and…
But I have this against you, that you left your first love.
Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly…
Wake up, and keep the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours…
As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.
Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him, and…

translations.web: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
